Proceedings of the Royal Society B 279:144–152 (2012). https://doi.org/10.1098/rspb.2011.0673. Abstract-level claims are paraphrased.

claims.text: A long-term metapopulation study found that natal dispersal in house sparrows increased with spring temperature and population size on lower-quality islands without farms, while these factors were not associated with dispersal on higher-quality farm islands.
claims.scope: Abstract-level result for the studied island populations; habitat-specific observational associations do not establish causality or a universal species pattern.
